主要内容: Berkery Noyes released its Q1 2012 Software Industry Mergers & Acquisitions Trend Report. Q1 2012 transaction value in the Software Industry increased 10 percent, while transaction volume declined 10 percent compared to the previous quarter. Financial software deals accounted for 52 percent of transactions, with capital markets being a key focus. Vista Equity Partners acquired Misys for $2 billion, the largest deal of the quarter. Oracle's $1.9 billion acquisition of Taleo was the largest business software transaction, while Blackbaud's $274 million acquisition of Convio was the tenth largest. Symantec's $115 million acquisition of LiveOffice was one of the largest infrastructure software deals. Security-focused transactions rose 75 percent compared to Q4 2011, with Safenet's acquisition of Cryptocard and TrustWave's acquisition of M86 Security highlighting demand for cloud-based cyber security solutions. Envestnet and SEI Investments acquired companies in wealth management. Twitter acquired Dasient, a cloud-based malware defense company, following its acquisition of Whisper Systems in Q4 2011. Berkery Noyes specializes in M&A and financial consulting for mid-market companies.
